body: Shipped profile/media/search/toast UX pass: shared content stays embedded with category pills and no View all; hero bottom has a deeper image blur plus page-color dissolve; action SF Symbols spring on tap; normal-chat search field has real geometry and a persistent bottom count/up/down navigator replacing the composer; profile thumbnails preserve their UIImageView into the existing chat zoom viewer; global toast morphs in place with inferred info/success/error/progress animated glyphs. Unsigned generic iOS source build green through agix; physical device and simulator services were unavailable in the sandbox, so Assets.xcassets and signing were excluded only for validation.
author: Vibe Team
